target_protocol: 4S common 5.1 A discharge to pack 11.2 V, nominal 102 Ah denominator
reference: CK0 finite-rate 4 cell discharge curves, Q0=100.41Ah; use monotone interpolated shape anchored at measured 11.2V endpoint
range_provenance: Q and SOC are analytic stress ranges, not measured official degradation; delta R spans official 10-60s apparent pulse-response quantiles and is an additional change relative to CK0, not pure R0; 20mV shape perturbation is stress uncertainty, not calibrated physical truth
safety_flag_only: report if a cell falls below 2.5V before group 11.2V; do not impose an unannounced cell cutoff
claim_boundary: S scenarios support mechanism and code verification only; no CK1-CK7 true capacity error
